sloka: अब्रवीत्तु तदा वाक्यं नारदो भगवानृषिः ।श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि विधानं च विधीयताम् ।। ७.२१.५ ॥
transliteration: abravīttu tadā vākyaṁ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi vidhānaṁ ca vidhīyatām ।। 7.21.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, the revered sage Narada spoke these words: "Listen, I will tell you the plan, and let it be carried out."
